summary: Aditxt, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the August 12, 2026 sale of its majority-owned subsidiary Pearsanta, Inc. to MDNA Holdings, Inc. via a Stock Purchase Agreement. Buyer acquired substantially all outstanding Pearsanta shares and assumed certain liabilities, excluding intercompany obligations. Aditxt received contingent consideration: a 2.5% royalty on net revenue capped at $2.5 million, plus $250,000 milestone payments upon a $10 million financing or change of control. No price per share or premium was disclosed. This divestiture reduces Aditxt's operational footprint; watch for Pearsanta's progress toward milestones to determine ultimate value realization.
